protocol.purpose: A second party tries to show that a lane's neutral-looking selection universe was gerrymandered, target-first, or made non-comparable by source access.
protocol.clearing_rule: Cleared requires a reviewer distinct from the universe author, at least two recorded boundary attacks, at least one plausible alternative universe, at least one comparator test, and a written disposition.
required_challenges: Move each temporal, geographic, institutional, source-family, and threshold boundary and record who enters or leaves.
Propose the strongest plausible alternative universe that answers the same public-interest question.
Apply the stated rule to at least one unflattering and one exculpatory or null comparator outcome.
Test whether differential source access, deletion, language, jurisdiction, or digitization makes symmetry merely nominal.

known_boundary_risks: Declared UK/US case sources may overrepresent English-language and digitally durable institutions.
Receipt-led expansion can inherit the seed case's institutional boundary.
reviews.disposition: Existing exports remain provisional and must carry the consumption contract until an independent challenge is recorded.

known_boundary_risks: A publisher-defined ranking universe may encode editorial and sponsor choices before this project applies its own rules.
The unrecovered 2025 image roster can distort longitudinal inclusion.
reviews.disposition: Lane remains staged and publication-blocked pending independent universe review and complete roster recovery.

known_boundary_risks: Configured APIs privilege digitized US records and sources that permit stable automated access.
Query-term choice can make an apparently complete source matrix target-first.
reviews.disposition: Source-plane outputs remain provisional and expose adapter failures, held rows, and query boundaries.

known_boundary_risks: The archive is egocentric and attention-selected, so it cannot support population or absence inference.
reviews.disposition: No public universe is claimed; private rows remain support-only and require separate public receipts for any assertion.

known_boundary_risks: Government release boundaries reflect institutional disclosure and redaction decisions rather than the universe of conduct.
Survivorship and publicity can overrepresent famous names and durable institutions.
reviews.disposition: Lane remains proposed and publication-blocked before source-complete hashing, privacy fixtures, and independent universe review.

known_boundary_risks: A named reference case can silently become target-first even when its predicates are written symmetrically.
Target-shaped predicates can force structural nulls for comparators even after an entity cohort is added.
Historical digitization and disclosure access vary sharply across the cohort and can masquerade as conduct differences.

review_assistance.live_probe_status: A non-release name-search probe exposed false positives; cycle-specific official FEC profiles now source-resolve 8 candidate IDs and 37 authorized presidential campaign committees, while the provisioned-key Schedule B run remains pending

boundary_attacks.method: Expand the declared identifier set literally and identify which people can enter before counterparty traversal.
boundary_attacks.finding: The prior universe began with one named person's candidate, committee, trust, business, issuer, property, and policy identifiers, so it enumerated the target and the target's counterparties while admitting comparators only counterfactually.

boundary_attacks.method: Apply the prior crossing descriptions to office-matched comparators and inspect whether the types were defined independently of known target-specific assets and policy topics.
boundary_attacks.finding: The prior descriptions encoded singular target instances as search predicates, allowing structurally forced comparator nulls even if the same query text were run for every person.

alternative_universes.definition: Every distinct person whose service as President of the United States intersects 1979-01-01 through the dated capture, enumerated from the official service roster before entity queries.
alternative_universes.why_stronger: Office, service date, and a fixed disclosure-era cutoff determine membership; party, wealth, business form, suspicion, and expected findings do not.

comparator_tests.method: Run the frozen five-predicate registry against all eight cohort members and preserve candidate, observation, finding, unavailable, rejected, and source-failure outcomes. Predicate 1 has cohort-wide FEC/OGE screening with zero crossings; predicate 2 has a provisional contract-award query for one member's six registry candidates and explicit seven-member entity-coverage gaps; predicates 3–5 remain unexecuted.
blocking_conditions: cohort-wide entity resolution absent
historical coverage remains asymmetric
predicates 3 through 5 have no result artifact

reviews.disposition: The prior target-first universe failed two attacks and has been replaced by an office-defined cohort and frozen role-neutral battery. The lane remains publication-blocked and pending a genuinely independent second-party challenge plus live comparator execution.

known_boundary_risks: One leak's service-provider and jurisdiction footprint is not the universe of offshore finance.
Registry accessibility varies by jurisdiction and can create false asymmetry in validation rates.
reviews.disposition: Lane remains proposed and publication-blocked until a licensed snapshot, privacy projection, and independent universe review exist.

known_boundary_risks: The supplied ten are famous, recent, and U.S.-heavy, so they cannot define the event universe.
Actor-centered stories can compress multi-person institutions into one gateholder without sufficient attribution evidence.
Strategic deception and designed exclusion can be mislabeled as sincere comprehension failure.
Paywalled, changed, or later-published sources can make apparent evidence symmetry illusory.
Credential bias can exclude situated and affected-party knowledge while overcrediting formal status.
Maintainer corrections can improve internal discipline while still reproducing the project author’s selection assumptions.
English-language and digitally durable sources remain overrepresented.
A source-present event can still lack the causal transition required by K0.

boundary_attacks.method: Ask whether the rule would have produced the same ten without their names or the source ranking.
boundary_attacks.finding: It would not. The ten are retained only as positive and boundary fixtures; the declared universe begins from gate actions preceded by contradictions.

boundary_attacks.method: Replace each named gateholder with the institution or decision chain unless a direct command, statement, vote, or signature is documented.
boundary_attacks.finding: Meta, Google, New College, HHS, and defense events require institution-level defaults with bounded personal attribution.

boundary_attacks.method: Try to infer inability, arrogance, intent, or bad faith from a firing, veto, or later failure alone.
boundary_attacks.finding: The method rejects private diagnosis and separates comprehension failure, status-protective reclassification, designed ceilings, strategic bypass, and mixed events.

boundary_attacks.method: Treat repeated explanation-laundering moves as an edge or common-purpose network among the ten.
boundary_attacks.finding: The wiring audit supports role homology only. It records zero justified common-purpose network edges among the ten.

alternative_universes.definition: Every source-addressable firing, veto, removal, access termination, appointment, funding action, accreditation decision, enforcement act, or legal conversion preceded by a documented contradiction.
Every event in which an institution loses, preserves, or restores a source of contradictory evidence, including negative and positive controls.

comparator_tests.method: For each gate class, compare events where independent review preserved standing or stayed action against events where the original gateholder controlled both classification and consequence.
blocking_conditions: Wave 08 field adjudication remains open
controls remain maintainer-selected
second-party review absent

comparator_tests.method: Apply identical event fields and failure-species rules across corporate, progressive, conservative, military, public-health, and election institutions.
blocking_conditions: fixtures are not a selected denominator
second-party review absent

comparator_tests.method: Compare formal proceedings, preliminary findings, final noncompliance, binding commitments, corrective plans, and statutory access controls without assuming that later correction proves earlier motive or present effectiveness.
blocking_conditions: individual researcher requests are not identified in the public decision summaries
corrective-plan effectiveness is not yet observed
independent review absent

comparator_tests.method: Compare warnings followed by management override or evidence denial against accident records lacking a documented pre-action contradiction and against long-lived recommendation streams lacking one bounded gate action.
blocking_conditions: accident severity cannot substitute for causal transitions
distributed institutional systems require event decomposition
maintainer CCD does not satisfy independent review

comparator_tests.method: Compare total committee resets and categorical eligibility exclusions against ordinary staggered turnover, public conflict registers, item-specific recusal, external audit, termination without a capture predicate, and seed-overlap deduplication.
blocking_conditions: member-specific contradiction and reclassification evidence remains absent from committee-wide summaries
post-action judicial correction cannot complete a pre-action K0 chain
control effectiveness is not independently observed
second-party review absent

comparator_tests.method: Compare candidate publication disputes against final misconduct-based retraction, binding authorship adjudication, scientific-integrity reporting, later institutional reversal, and an explicitly bounded case index.
blocking_conditions: the Karolinska packet does not establish the causal bridge from contradiction to knower reclassification
the Olivieri packet remains a maintainer-supported CCD-6 review candidate rather than an included event
later correction cannot be projected backward into prior knowledge or motive
policy existence does not prove observed stopping power
second-party review absent

comparator_tests.method: Compare protected professional judgment followed by chain-of-command, loyalty, reckless-disregard, or non-selection consequences against lawful insubordination standards, policy-level chilling without substantiated reprisal, reclassification without adverse action, and independent stay or correction controls.
blocking_conditions: the FBI technician packet reaches provisional CCD 4 but realized appraisal or assignment loss and final OARM correction remain unobserved
the FBI analyst packet lacks the initial governing explanation, knower reclassification, and explanation mutation despite documented non-selections
the Jacobs packet reaches provisional CCD 6 but contains mixed independent discipline evidence, multiple decisionmakers, and incomplete remedy records
reprisal findings do not by themselves establish the complete K0 chain
lawful discipline requires proof of an authorized order and willful refusal
stay and correction controls do not prove final merits or universal effectiveness
second-party review absent

comparator_tests.method: Compare induced or disputed resignations, transfers, editorial silence, and accepted-resignation accounts against independent constructive-discharge correction, statutory appeals, admitted-misconduct departures, and seed-overlap deduplication.
blocking_conditions: the Honl packet documents downstream gate action and sensor loss but not the gateholder authorship-transfer explanation or early causal bridge
the constructive-discharge packet is a bounded non-link because no qualified K0 contradiction, competence reclassification, or authorship-transfer explanation is identified
the involuntary-transfer packet preserves an exact voluntary/involuntary conflict but lacks knower reclassification and feedback-source removal
constructive-discharge and appeal controls do not prove universal access, timely stays, or complete remedy
second-party review absent

comparator_tests.method: Compare qualified contrary advice followed by appointment, removal, replacement, resignation under threatened removal, or board action against investigation-grounded command relief, removals with identified inquiry and rationale, statutory notice and continuity protections, independent stays, and no-removal advisory continuity.
blocking_conditions: four candidate packets await contiguous stage adjudication
minority-staff and self-reported resignation evidence require source-class limits
investigation-grounded controls do not prove every removal lawful
stay and notice controls do not prove final merits or observed universal effectiveness
second-party review absent

reviews.disposition: Eight name-blind waves execute all nine frozen query templates and preserve employment, access, safety, committee, publication, professional-judgment, authorship-transfer, contrary-advice, negative, coverage, correction, and counterpower records. Publication remains blocked because Wave 08 field adjudication, the Temu request-level acquisition, exact remote custody, and genuinely independent review remain incomplete.

findings: CCD previously conflated furthest documented consequence with cumulative chain completion.
General qualifications or institutional function were sometimes substituted for a contradiction delivered to the gateholder.
Attempted feedback removal and attempted blockage were counted as completed stages.
One positive fixture required demotion to boundary status.
Two restricted sources and one commentary-dependent claim required substitute or primary-source upgrades.
